title: Timed motor start and fault reset
goal: A controls technician can see that a start request waits five seconds before motor energisation and that an overload fault latches until reset.

rubric.must: A TON function block clearly identifies StartDelay and a five-second preset.
A contact labelled StartDelay.Q appears on the rung that energises the MotorRun coil.
The start pushbutton and StartRequest holding contact form a visible parallel latch path to a StartRequest set coil.
An OverloadTrip contact visibly drives a FaultLatch set coil on its own rung.
Normally closed FaultLatch contacts are visible in the timed-start or motor-run logic.
A ResetPB contact visibly operates a FaultLatch reset coil.
Repeated tags for StartRequest, StartDelay and FaultLatch are readable and consistent across their separate rungs.
